name: Lampir
source:
A refined and flamboyant Lampir, living in a manor.

Agency assessment: Popular literature exposure led to members of the vampire species being one of the most popular category. While this peculiar specimen does not sparkle under the sun, its handsome appearance and love for the spot light makes it dazzling regardless. Potential candidates are strong advised to be wary of their gazes.

[From [url=https://sunlit-dreamer.itch.io/whats-your-name]itch.io[/url]]

[spoiler]His name is Sixte[spoiler]
